name: Remote for ADI-2
subtitle: Remote control for RME ADI-2 devices

apps.name: Remote for ADI-2
apps.subtitle: Remote control for ADI-2 DAC, ADI-2 Pro and ADI-2/4 Pro
apps.localizedDescription: Remote control for the RME ADI-2 DAC, ADI-2 Pro, ADI-2 Pro EX, ADI-2/4 Pro SE and ADI-2/4 Pro EX over USB or Wi-Fi (via Remote for ADI-2 Host on Mac/Windows). Outputs and volume, parametric EQ, device settings, setups, analyzer and a custom control panel. Free and open source (GPL-3.0). RME and ADI-2 are trademarks of RME Intelligent Audio Solutions.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 1.3.0: host-to-host control, clearer host overview (active connection marked), CLIENT badge, faster analyzer, layout improvements.
First iPhone release. Build 10: the analyzer now finds the ADI-2 USB input on iPhones where iOS reports it as a wired microphone (for example iPhone 15).

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scans the QR code to pair with Remote for ADI-2 Host.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The analyzer records USB audio from the ADI-2 while visible. Audio is not saved and the phone microphone is not used.
privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Shows the current Apple Music track and controls playback.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connects to Remote for ADI-2 Host on your computer over Wi-Fi.
